<!-- LTVCR: bring back the CTA van slide-in and the flashing headlights.
     Paste this into Base44 custom code / code snippets, in the <head> slot.
     It is CSS only. No script, so nothing for the importer to strip and
     nothing that a React re-render can undo. -->
<style>
/* The built-in rules wait for a class that only JavaScript adds, which never
   happens once scripts are stripped. These run unconditionally instead. */
.cta-rig .cta-beam{
  animation: ltvcrBeam 5s ease-in-out 1.15s infinite !important;
}
@keyframes ltvcrBeam{
  0%   { opacity:0 }
  5%   { opacity:1 }
  9%   { opacity:.12 }
  13%  { opacity:1 }
  20%  { opacity:.85 }
  30%  { opacity:0 }
  100% { opacity:0 }
}

/* The van drives in from the right once, on load. */
.cta-rig{
  animation: ltvcrVanIn 1.25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both !important;
}
@keyframes ltvcrVanIn{
  from { translate: 52% 0; opacity:0 }
  to   { translate: none;  opacity:1 }
}

/* Respect a reduced-motion preference: hold the lights on, no movement. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .cta-rig{ animation:none !important; translate:none !important; opacity:1 !important }
  .cta-rig .cta-beam{ animation:none !important; opacity:.55 !important }
}
</style>
body:
<!-- LTVCR: hero booking bar - put the Get My Quote button back on the field row.
     Paste into Base44 code snippets, BODY slot. CSS only, no script.

     The Cloudflare Turnstile is hidden, but its container is still a child of the
     booking bar's grid, so it keeps occupying the button's column and pushes the
     button to a second row. This orders the button ahead of it and collapses the
     empty container so it takes no space. The widget stays in the DOM and keeps
     running, so its verification token is unaffected. -->
<style>
.bookbar > .bb-field{ order:1 }
.bookbar > .bb-go{ order:2 }

/* anything Base44 or Cloudflare injects into the bar */
.bookbar > *:not(.bb-field):not(.bb-go){
  order:3;
  grid-column:1 / -1;
  margin:0 !important;      /* the widget carries an inline margin:12px 0 */
  height:0;
  min-height:0;
  overflow:hidden;
}
</style>
footer:
<script >
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.wpforms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'website_forms', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'website_calls', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>
